context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 貸し出し/同種/同業/各県/各党/引き継が/積み立て/役立て

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察備品の貸し出し、御社にも認可しました。
lines.en: We've authorized your firm to borrow police equipment.
lines.style: Even, professional opener. Measured pace. Slight formal distance — this is official business being confirmed. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同種の協定、他社とも結びました。
lines.en: Yes. We've established similar agreements with other companies as well.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady, reliable tone. Neither rushing nor hesitating. Showing competence without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 同業者間で情報共有、防犯に役立てて。
lines.en: Information-sharing between industries will support our crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Instructional but not condescending. Clear enunciation. Slight emphasis on the practical benefit. Brief, efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各県警と連携を強化します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen our coordination with each prefectural police department.
lines.style: Formal confirmation. Careful, deliberate phrasing. Shows he understands the weight of the commitment. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 各党の予算審議、警察関連、注目しています。
lines.en: We're watching the budget discussions in the Diet regarding police funding.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, observational tone. Slight lean forward indicating attentiveness. No urgency, but clear focus. Practical note-taking quality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。担当が引き継がれた後も、連絡密にします。
lines.en: Yes. Even after the transition, we'll maintain regular contact.
lines.style: Firm reassurance. Unhurried. Emphasis on continuity and reliability. Shows this is a pledge, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 積み立て型の協力基金、検討中ですね。
lines.en: We're currently considering a reserve-type cooperation fund.
lines.style: Neutral, exploratory tone. Measured delivery suggesting this is still in development stages. No pressure, but genuine interest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。実績を役立てます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll put our experience to good use.
lines.style: Quiet closing. Assured but not boastful. Final note of understated confidence. Polite fade-out.
